candidates.change_summary: Replaced the admin check require with its negation so only non-admins can call updateWinnersPerPeriod, causing successful calls by previous admins to revert and leaving winnersPerPeriod unchanged when called by admins.
Removed the admin check so anyone can call updateWinnersPerPeriod, allowing non-admin callers to change winnersPerPeriod.
Kept the admin check but added an extra statement doubling the assigned value, so winnersPerPeriod becomes twice the provided argument after successful calls.
Kept the admin check but instead assigns winnersPerPeriod to a constant (1), ignoring the provided argument.
Kept the admin check but increments winnersPerPeriod by the provided amount instead of setting it, making the state diverge from direct assignment.
